theme_strategy.rationale: Nature-inspired, warm, and inviting coffee shop with a premium artisan feel.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-medium tracking-tighter text-[#1A3626] leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#1A3626] leading-snug

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for main sections. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.
layouts.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large serif heading on the left, high-quality Unsplash image on the right with a subtle overlapping card or hours widget. Ensure the background is cream (#F9F6F0) to keep it warm.
layouts.menu: Categorized sections (Espresso, Brewed, Cold, Signature, Food/Pastries). Grid layout: 2 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile. Each item should have a title, description, and price with a dotted line connecting the item and price if possible. 6-8 items per section.
layouts.about: Editorial spread style. Large prominent photo of shop interior with overlapping text boxes. Use negative space to highlight the 'story'.
layouts.contact: 2-column grid. Left: Minimalist Contact form UI. Right: Hours, Address, and a stylized empty state/placeholder for the map. Mark map as TODO.
layouts.header: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80) with 1px bottom border (#E5DFD3). Links right-aligned with hamburger for mobile.
layouts.footer: Dark mode footer (bg-[#1A3626] text-[#F9F6F0]) for contrast. Large typography for 'Charlie's Coffee'.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#1A3626] text-white hover:bg-[#12261b]. Accent: bg-[#CC5803] text-white hover:bg-[#a34602]. Subtle transform -translate-y-0.5 on hover.
components.cards: Flat design, rounded-2xl, border border-[#E5DFD3] bg-white. No heavy drop shadows. Keep it clean.
components.forms: Minimalist inputs. Softly rounded borders (rounded-lg border-[#E5DFD3] bg-transparent focus:border-[#1A3626]).
components.hours_widget: Small dynamic pill badge in header or hero. Evaluates current time (JS) and shows a pulsing green dot with 'Open now' or gray dot with 'Closed'.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise SVG overlay (2% opacity) on the main cream background to mimic artisan paper.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer motion for subtle fade-up entrance on scroll. Very slow and smooth transitions (duration: 0.6s).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px #E5DFD3 borders to create structure (bento-like grid) in the featured items and menu.

hero_ambient.description: Cozy cafe interior with vintage design, use for About page or Hero ambient background.

latte_art.description: Close-up pouring latte art. Use for Featured Items or Menu section.

pastries.description: Coffee and baked breads/croissants. Use for Food/Pastries menu section.

iced_coffee.description: Close-up of iced coffee. Use for Cold Drinks menu section.

espresso.description: Steaming espresso shot. Use for Espresso menu section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure burnt orange (#CC5803) text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against cream. Deep green (#1A3626) provides excellent contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#CC5803] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a standard React frontend with React Router for 4 pages: Home, Menu, About, Contact.
Import Google Fonts: 'Fraunces' and 'DM Sans' in index.html or index.css.
Implement frontend JS logic for the hours widget to dynamically display 'Open now' or 'Closed' based on local time.
Leave explicit TODO comments for all backend hooks: Contact form submission, Map placeholder, Newsletter signup.
Use framer-motion to add subtle scroll reveal animations to major sections.
Add tailwind configuration with the exact custom colors and font families specified.
Ensure the design remains fully responsive (mobile-first).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
